model: triaxial high-j particle plus quartic octupole double well
status: synthetic diagnostic; not a fit to any nucleus

discrete_algebra.interpretation: P and Rx are commuting spatial symmetries. Four local states require independent chirality and octupole-sign sectors; antiunitary chiral operations can add a projective phase but are not represented by [Rx,S].

interpretation.double_modulation: V_signature(p,I)=V_triax+p*V_oct+V_Coriolis(p,I), so parity changes the interference phase.
interpretation.two_regimes: The residual S(I) branches separate smoothly at low spin and can bifurcate when the Coriolis term becomes comparable to the triaxial and octupole amplitudes.
interpretation.simplex_boundary: A deepening double well makes the tunnelling gap exponentially small; q_min grows. A restoring term makes q_min vanish with mean-field exponent 1/2 while the local harmonic gap need not vanish.
